subject: general
question: The average temperature for Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday was 48ºC, and for Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday was 46ºC. If the temperature on Monday was 42ºC, find the temperature on Friday.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net difference between **Monday** and **Friday** = Number of days × (Difference in averages)

⇒ **Monday** − **Friday** = 4 × (48 − 46) = 4 × 2 = 8°C

⇒ 42 − **Friday** = 8

⇒ **Friday** = 42 − 8 = 34°C

**∴ The correct answer is 34°C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59073e44e9ff1654d4f73c9fbbf505a31cafa33bb1df6f532b123e2644dddd41.png] 

**Given:**

Average (Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu) = 48°C

Average (Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri) = 46°C

Temperature on Monday = 42°C

**Formula Used:**

Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum(Mon + Tue + Wed + Thu) = 48 × 4 = 192°C

⇒ Sum(Tue + Wed + Thu + Fri) = 46 × 4 = 184°C

⇒ (Mon + Tue + Wed + Thu) − (Tue + Wed + Thu + Fri) = 192 − 184

⇒ Mon − Fri = 8°C

⇒ 42 − Fri = 8

⇒ Fri = 42 − 8 = 34°C

**∴ The correct answer is 34°C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average of a Group

Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations).

Deviation Method

If one member is replaced, the change in sum = (Number of members) × (Change in Average).

Temperature Problems

In overlapping day series, common days cancel out when subtracting the total sums of the two sets.</p
